name: Half-bleed image beside a connected sequence
useWhen: Three to five named moves in order, where the subject deserves a full-height image.

focal.note: Measured as width against headline size because the focal element here is an area, not a glyph. The image owns 44% of the canvas; anything less and the slide becomes a list with a picture.

replacesNote: image-content-v2 pairs the same half-bleed with a single paragraph. This adds the sequence and the connector. Both are worth keeping — v2 when there is one thing to say, this when there are four in order.
